scripts.desktop:dev:office: npm run build:electron && concurrently -k "cross-env VITE_APP_VARIANT=office vite --host 127.0.0.1 --port 5173" "wait-on http://127.0.0.1:5173 && cross-env COPILOT_VARIANT=office VITE_DEV_SERVER_URL=http://127.0.0.1:5173 electron ."
scripts.desktop:dev:developer: npm run build:electron && concurrently -k "cross-env VITE_APP_VARIANT=developer vite --host 127.0.0.1 --port 5173" "wait-on http://127.0.0.1:5173 && cross-env COPILOT_VARIANT=developer VITE_DEV_SERVER_URL=http://127.0.0.1:5173 electron ."
scripts.build:renderer:office: cross-env VITE_APP_VARIANT=office vite build && node scripts/prepare-sites-build.mjs
scripts.build:renderer: npm run build:renderer:office && npm run build:renderer:developer
scripts.build:office: npm run typecheck && npm run build:electron && npm run build:renderer:office
scripts.build:developer: npm run typecheck && npm run build:electron && npm run build:renderer:developer
scripts.build: npm run typecheck && npm run build:electron && npm run build:renderer
scripts.start:office: npm run build:office && cross-env COPILOT_VARIANT=office electron .
scripts.start:developer: npm run build:developer && cross-env COPILOT_VARIANT=developer electron .
scripts.dist:win:office: npm run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.office.json --win nsis
scripts.dist:win:developer: npm run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.developer.json --win nsis
scripts.dist:mac:office: npm run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.office.json --mac dmg
scripts.dist:mac:developer: npm run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.developer.json --mac dmg
